name: α-D-galactose to 2-O-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α…
summary: A 6-step route from α-D-galactose to 2-O-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-glucosyl]-D-glycerate, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: N-acylsphingosine galactosyltransferase
reactions.equation: a N-(2-hydroxyacyl)sphing-4-enine + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = a 1-(beta-D-galactosyl)-2-(2-hydroxyacyl)sphing-4-enine + UDP + H(+)

reactions.name: N-acetyllactosaminide 3-alpha-galactosyltransferase
reactions.equation: a beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = an alpha-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl derivative + UDP + H(+)

reactions.name: fucosylgalactoside 3-alpha-galactosyltransferase
reactions.equation: an alpha-L-fucosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-galactosyl derivative + UDP-alpha-D-galactose = an alpha-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-[alpha-L-fucosyl-(1->2)]-beta-D-galactosyl derivative + UDP + H(+)

reactions.name: O-phosphoserine--tRNA ligase
reactions.equation: tRNA(Cys) + O-phospho-L-serine + ATP = O-phospho-L-seryl-tRNA(Cys) + AMP + diphosphate

reactions.name: GDP-mannose 6-dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: GDP-alpha-D-mannose + 2 NAD(+) + H2O = GDP-alpha-D-mannuronate + 2 NADH + 3 H(+)
